passages: [prose] Most carabids specialized in feeding on Collembola occurred in older successional stages, these being shady and more humid habitats that presumably favor higher Collembolan abundances. Active hunting spiders were dominant in open grey dunes, as previously shown by Finch (1997). Due to lower spatial resistance active hunting species, such as Lycosidae, are favored, while ambush and web hunters require well-developed habitat architecture, which is usually not given in grey dunes.
